fact: The National Information Technology Agency (NITA) put out its draft Data Harmonisation Bill 2025 and invited all stakeholders and the general public, including citizens, academia and the private sector, to make submissions in a public consultation announced on 2025-10-23 and set to run from 2025-11-19 to 2025-11-27 via the consultation document on its website.

Ghana's OGP Secretariat and Multi-Stakeholder Forum co-created the fifth Open Government Partnership National Action Plan (NAP 5) in 2023 with civil society organisations (including GACC, GII, CDD, IDEG and MFWA) and government agencies in consultative meetings and an October 2023 co-creation workshop, and the plan carries commitments on misinformation on digital platforms, on amending the Electronic Communications Act 2008, and on data sharing and open data (published 2023-12, event dated October 2023).
